value: Disconnect closed: T1 and T18 supply 24 VAC to the controls; TB13 feeds line voltage to crankcase heaters, compressors, blower and fan motors.
G: A55 energizes blower contactor K3; K3-1 closes and runs blower B3.
Economizer (if equipped): A55 energizes power exhaust relay K65 at 50% outside-air damper travel (adjustable); exhaust fans B10/B11 run.
Y1: A55 proves N.C. low pressure switches S87/S88, freezestats S49/S50 and high pressure switches S4/S7, then energizes K1 and K2. Compressors B1 and B2 start.
Condenser fans: A55 cycles fan relays K10/K68 (and others) from the low ambient switches and outdoor temperature. Fan-relay N.C. contacts drop out the crankcase heaters while the fans run.
Y2: 24 VAC to A59, which proves S98/S97, S53/S95 and S28/S96, then energizes K14 and K146. Compressors B13 and B20 start; A59 runs fan contactors K150/K152/K153 from S85/S94.
A safety opening drops that compressor. Three HPS trips per demand, or three LPS strikes after the start-up shunt, lock it out until the demand is broken or the control is reset.

cooling-95F.note: Pressures fit LCH240H Table 17 at 95°F (p.51: suction 113-163, discharge 383-393 psig), liquid temp matches the circuit 1 charging curve (p.67: ~97°F at 130 psig). Amps sit under the 460 V RLA of 6.3 A and fan FLA of 1.3 A (p.20). Superheat, return/supply temps, and blower amps are still representative values.

readings.txt_tstat: BAS shows occupied, G on, Y1 and Y2 called. Space 76°F, setpoint 72°F.
readings.txt_controller: A55 status: blower on, Y1 and Y2 demand, compressors 1-4 on. No active alarms.
readings.txt_look_unit: Unit running. Compressors humming steady, condenser fans spinning, blower running. No odd noises.
readings.txt_look_condenser: Condenser coil reasonably clean. All fans turning, warm air off the top.
readings.txt_look_evap: Filters moderately loaded. Coil clean and sweating evenly. Belt tension good.
readings.txt_look_electrical: Panel clean. No burn marks or discolored wire. Contactors look fine.
readings.txt_look_economizer: Damper at about 20% open. Linkage tight, coupling secure. Mixed air sensor mounted downstream of the dampers, ahead of the filters.
readings.txt_manual_stroke: Damper strokes freely through full travel by hand.
readings.txt_jade_checkout: DAMPER OPEN: actuator drives full open, blades follow. DAMPER CLOSE: drives closed, blades seal.
